question: List all genres.
gold_sql: SELECT genre_id, name FROM genre ORDER BY genre_id LIMIT 100;

question: Find all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT media_type_id, name FROM media_type ORDER BY media_type_id LIMIT 100;

question: Show customers who live in Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, country FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil' LIMIT 100;

question: List all playlists.
gold_sql: SELECT playlist_id, name FROM playlist LIMIT 100;

question: Find tracks that have unit price greater than 0.99.
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, unit_price FROM track WHERE unit_price > 0.99 LIMIT 100;

question: Show invoices with a total greater than 15.
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, total FROM invoice WHERE total > 15 LIMIT 100;

question: List all employees located in Calgary.
gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, city FROM employee WHERE city = 'Calgary' LIMIT 100;

question: Find all albums by artist id 1.
gold_sql: SELECT album_id, title, artist_id FROM album WHERE artist_id = 1 LIMIT 100;

question: List each track name along with its album title.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS track_name, al.title AS album_title FROM track t JOIN album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id LIMIT 100;

question: Show albums along with their artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT al.title AS album_title, ar.name AS artist_name FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id LIMIT 100;

question: List all invoices along with the customer's first name, last name, and billing country.
gold_sql: SELECT i.invoice_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, i.billing_country, i.total FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LIMIT 100;

question: Find track names and their corresponding genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS track_name, g.name AS genre_name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id LIMIT 100;

question: List tracks that belong to the playlist named 'Heavy Metal Classic'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.track_id, t.name AS track_name FROM track t JOIN playlist_track pt ON t.track_id = pt.track_id JOIN playlist p ON pt.playlist_id = p.playlist_id WHERE p.name = 'Heavy Metal Classic' LIMIT 100;

question: Show each customer's first and last name along with the first and last name of their support representative.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name AS customer_first, c.last_name AS customer_last, e.first_name AS rep_first, e.last_name AS rep_last FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id LIMIT 100;

question: List invoice line items with the track name and invoice total.
gold_sql: SELECT il.invoice_line_id, t.name AS track_name, i.total FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LIMIT 100;

question: Find tracks and their media type names for tracks in genre id 1.
gold_sql: SELECT t.track_id, t.name AS track_name, m.name AS media_type FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON t.media_type_id = m.media_type_id WHERE t.genre_id = 1 LIMIT 100;

question: List all employees and the name of their manager.
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name AS employee_first, e.last_name AS employee_last, m.first_name AS manager_first, m.last_name AS manager_last FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id LIMIT 100;

question: Show the artist name, album title, and track name for tracks composed by 'AC/DC'.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, t.name AS track_name FROM track t JOIN album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id JOIN artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE t.composer = 'AC/DC' LIMIT 100;

question: How many total customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customer LIMIT 100;

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_revenue FROM invoice LIMIT 100;

question: What are the top 5 countries by total sales amount?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS total_sales FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which 5 artists have released the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(al.album_id) AS album_count FROM artist ar JOIN album al ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average duration of tracks in milliseconds per genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, AVG(t.milliseconds) AS avg_duration FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name LIMIT 100;

question: How many tracks are in each playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS playlist_name, COUNT(pt.track_id) AS track_count FROM playlist p LEFT JOIN playlist_track pt ON p.playlist_id = pt.playlist_id GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 100;

question: What is the total sales amount per year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS invoice_year, SUM(total) AS annual_sales FROM invoice GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) ORDER BY invoice_year LIMIT 100;

question: Find the top 5 customers who have spent the most in total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many invoices were billed to each country?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY invoice_count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Which 5 genres have the highest number of tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count FROM genre g JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find tracks that have never been purchased.
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name FROM track WHERE track_id NOT IN (SELECT track_id FROM invoice_line) LIMIT 100;

question: Show artists who have more than 5 albums using a subquery or CTE.
gold_sql: WITH artist_albums AS (SELECT artist_id, COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM album GROUP BY artist_id) SELECT ar.name, aa.album_count FROM artist ar JOIN artist_albums aa ON ar.artist_id = aa.artist_id WHERE aa.album_count > 5 LIMIT 100;

question: Find customers who spent more than the average total invoice amount.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM invoice GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(total) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM invoice)) LIMIT 100;

question: List albums where all tracks are longer than 3 minutes (180000 ms).
gold_sql: SELECT album_id, title FROM album WHERE album_id NOT IN (SELECT album_id FROM track WHERE milliseconds <= 180000) LIMIT 100;

question: Find the track with the longest duration.
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, milliseconds FROM track WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM track) LIMIT 1;

question: Using a CTE, find the total number of tracks sold per country and return the highest selling country.
gold_sql: WITH country_sales AS (SELECT i.billing_country, SUM(il.quantity) AS total_tracks FROM invoice i JOIN invoice_line il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY i.billing_country) SELECT billing_country, total_tracks FROM country_sales ORDER BY total_tracks DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find customers who have never made a purchase.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM invoice) LIMIT 100;

question: List tracks whose unit price is higher than the average track unit price.
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, unit_price FROM track WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM track) LIMIT 100;

question: Show invoices from the year 2023.
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2023 LIMIT 100;

question: List invoices created between 2022-01-01 and 2022-12-31.
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date <= '2022-12-31' LIMIT 100;

question: Find employees hired in or after 2020.
gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employee WHERE hire_date >= '2020-01-01' LIMIT 100;

question: Find monthly total sales for the year 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date) AS invoice_month, SUM(total) AS monthly_sales FROM invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2024 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date) ORDER BY invoice_month LIMIT 12;

question: What was the date of the very first invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(invoice_date) AS first_invoice_date FROM invoice LIMIT 1;

question: Show the latest 5 invoices ordered by date descending.
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice ORDER BY invoice_date DESC LIMIT 5;
